Root.modal.semantic: true = focus trap + scroll lock + outside pointer interactions disabled; false = page interaction allowed; 'trap-focus' = focus trapped, no scroll lock, outside pointer allowed

Root.disablePointerDismissal.semantic: blocks outside-press dismissal; for non-modal dialogs it also blocks focus-out dismissal

Root.actionsRef.type: RefObject<{ unmount: () => void; close: () => void } | null>
Root.actionsRef.semantic: unmount after externally controlled closing animation

Root.handle.semantic: detached triggers; Handle methods open(triggerId|null), openWithPayload(payload), close(); readonly isOpen

Trigger.id.semantic: forwarded + used as active trigger id in controlled mode

Trigger.handle / payload.semantic: detached trigger + payload to Root render function

Backdrop.forceRender.semantic: force the backdrop to render even when nested

Popup.initialFocus.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement|null> | ((openType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
Popup.initialFocus.semantic: default: first tabbable element, except touch where the popup itself is focused to avoid the virtual keyboard

Popup.finalFocus.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement|null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
Popup.finalFocus.semantic: default: trigger or previously focused element

Close.nativeButton.semantic: render <Dialog.Close> inside Popup when modal so touch screen readers can escape

Viewport.semantic: positioning container that can be made scrollable; mirrors Popup's open/nested state attributes

dataAttributes: Popup: data-open, data-closed, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-nested, data-nested-dialog-open
Viewport: data-open, data-closed, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-nested, data-nested-dialog-open
Popup CSS var: --nested-dialogs (number of dialogs nested inside)
renderProp: Per-part `render` (ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement) via useRender; state props auto-map to data-* attributes; merge with mergeProps.
controlled: Uncontrolled `defaultOpen`/`defaultTriggerId` + `onOpenChangeComplete`; controlled `open`/`triggerId` with `onOpenChange(open, eventDetails)`; imperative via `actionsRef` ({ unmount, close }) and `Dialog.createHandle()` → open(triggerId|null) / openWithPayload(payload) / close() / isOpen.
formIntegration: None: Dialog renders no hidden inputs and has no name/value or form-validation integration (verified across dialog/*.mjs). Docs example uses a plain <form> inside the popup and closes it from the form's submit handler; Trigger/Close render native <button> so type must be set explicitly inside forms.
keyboard: Focus trap when modal (true or 'trap-focus'); Escape dismissal is applied only when the dialog is topmost (`escapeKey: isTopmost` in useDialogRoot) so nested dialogs close innermost-first; page scroll is locked only when modal === true; composite keys are stopped inside the popup; focus returns via finalFocus (trigger or previously focused element). No arrow-key navigation inside dialog content.
notableDifferences: `modal` defaults to TRUE here (React Aria's Dialog is non-modal by default) and additionally accepts 'trap-focus'.
No isKeyboardDismissDisabled: veto Escape via eventDetails.cancel() in onOpenChange.
No isDismissable prop: use disablePointerDismissal (which also blocks focus-out dismissal for non-modal dialogs).
Nested dialogs are first-class: data-nested / data-nested-dialog-open / --nested-dialogs (React Aria has no nested-dialog state).
Focus control lives on Popup (initialFocus/finalFocus with InteractionType) instead of Dialog-level autoFocus/restoreFocus.
Viewport is a new separate positioning/scroll container part in 1.8.
Animation uses data-starting-style / data-ending-style; `unmount` imperative action exists for externally controlled closing animations.
Detached triggers + payload plumbing (createHandle/openWithPayload) replace React Aria's triggerRef/isOpen imperative-only control.
